channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 473 Hekate
item.description: 473 · Hekate Hekate is the ascendant god of Magic.

item.title: 170 Elementals
item.description: 170 · Elementals The Progenitor named Genasi made the elementals with help from the dragons, and took the five elemental realms of Tarkis as the model.

item.title: 180 Earthborn
item.description: 180 · Earthborn Talav made the earthborn. Gnomes, dwarves, and halflings, all three playable.

item.title: 210 Geno
item.description: 210 · Geno Founded in the second year of the Age of the Many, the first kingdom there was.

item.title: 212 Sylfaen
item.description: 212 · Sylfaen Founded in 2 AM. Beastfolk, and the strongest kingdom in the world since beating Krotaphos in 427 AM. Capital: Dawara.

item.title: 214 Starkon
item.description: 214 · Starkon Founded in 3 AM. One of the three kingdoms of the Trois Re, which it calls the Drei Kunig. Capital: Hekatania.

item.title: 215 Mathair
item.description: 215 · Mathair Founded in 3 AM, on the same day as Regno. One of the three kingdoms of the Trois Re.

item.title: 216 Regno
item.description: 216 · Regno Founded in 3 AM, the same day as Mathair. The third kingdom of the Trois Re, which it calls the Tre Regis. Capital: Caragna.

item.title: 217 Thalanea
item.description: 217 · Thalanea Formed in 105 AM when the kingdom of Thalamas tore itself in half.

item.title: 243 Passing Through Tarkis
item.description: 243 · Passing Through Tarkis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me.
